eyebrow: Cross-Platform Relational Database Administration · Chapter Seven
subtitle: Lesson 36 · MySQL Architecture & Installation

code:
[mysqld]
port = 3306
datadir = /var/lib/mysql
innodb_buffer_pool_size = 4G
max_connections = 200
bind-address = 127.0.0.1

[client]
port = 3306
socket = /var/run/mysqld/mysqld.sock
caption: [mysqld] configures the server process; [client] configures command-line client defaults.
SHOW VARIABLES shows the session's value; SHOW GLOBAL VARIABLES shows the server-wide value.
SET GLOBAL alone doesn't survive a restart unless it's also written to my.cnf, or you use SET PERSIST.
